description: Every settings section locked: the web client as the sandbox's non-admin viewer while accessroles-settings-locks-probe.mjs has given it a role that locks every settings section. GET /AccessRoles/Me reports the locks; Home and the Settings menu load, the menu with every section's link hidden and the note above Sign out; every settings page typed by hand ends on Home (the web guard; earlier builds showed them); a save of the configuration and of the usersettings document through jellyfin-web's own ApiClient, every locked value changed, leaves the server's values as they were (the merges) and the guard says so in a toast. The probe checks that no request of the API failed and that viewer's settings are as before. The webcheck also runs the pages' own form saves, with the guard switched off for this page only (an init script makes the head's server flags say enforcement is off, so nothing is hidden or redirected; the server still enforces): the Home screen page's Hide watched content from Latest and the Display page's Display missing episodes, changed and saved through their forms, are kept by the server, which answers X-AccessRoles-Kept naming Home and Display (account); the usersettings document is put back as it was.

steps.script: const ends = {}; for (const route of ['userprofile', 'mypreferencesplayback', 'mypreferencessubtitles', 'mypreferencescontrols', 'quickconnect', 'mypreferenceshome', 'mypreferencesdisplay']) { location.hash = '#/' + route; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); ends[route] = location.hash; } return ends;

steps.name: each ended on Home (the web guard)
the usersettings document before
save the configuration with locked values changed, through jellyfin-web's ApiClient
steps.script: const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const c = (await ApiClient.getUser(id)).Configuration; c.HidePlayedInLatest = !c.HidePlayedInLatest; c.DisplayMissingEpisodes = !c.DisplayMissingEpisodes; c.SubtitleMode = c.SubtitleMode === 'Always' ? 'None' : 'Always'; c.PlayDefaultAudioTrack = !c.PlayDefaultAudioTrack; await ApiClient.updateUserConfiguration(id, c); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfar-toast')].map((t) => t.textContent);

steps.name: save the usersettings document with a home section and the skip length changed
steps.script: const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const p = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', id, 'emby'); p.CustomPrefs = p.CustomPrefs || {}; p.CustomPrefs.homesection0 = p.CustomPrefs.homesection0 === 'resume' ? 'latestmedia' : 'resume'; p.CustomPrefs.skipForwardLength = '45000'; await ApiClient.updateDisplayPreferences('usersettings', p, id, 'emby'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return true;

steps.name: the server kept every locked value, and the guard said so
steps.assert: (async () => { const c = (await ApiClient.getUser(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId())).Configuration; const p = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), 'emby'); return c.HidePlayedInLatest === __vars.before.HidePlayedInLatest && c.DisplayMissingEpisodes === __vars.before.DisplayMissingEpisodes && c.SubtitleMode === __vars.before.SubtitleMode && c.PlayDefaultAudioTrack === __vars.before.PlayDefaultAudioTrack && (p.CustomPrefs || {}).homesection0 === (__vars.prefsBefore.CustomPrefs || {}).homesection0 && (p.CustomPrefs || {}).skipForwardLength === (__vars.prefsBefore.CustomPrefs || {}).skipForwardLength && __vars.configToasts.some((t) => t.indexOf('so they weren') >= 0); })()

steps.name: the guard off for this page (an init script: the head's flags say enforcement is off), and a recorder of the settings saves' answers
steps.initScript: (() => { let head; Object.defineProperty(window, '__jfarHead', { configurable: true, get() { return head; }, set(v) { head = Object.assign({}, v, { enforced: false }); } }); window.__jfarSaves = []; const f = window.fetch; window.fetch = function (input, init) { const p = f.apply(this, arguments); const url = String((input && input.url) || input); const method = String((init && init.method) || (input && input.method) || 'GET').toUpperCase(); if (method !== 'GET' && /\/(DisplayPreferences|Users)\//.test(url)) { p.then((r) => { window.__jfarSaves.push({ method: method, path: url.replace(/^.*?\/\/[^/]+/, '').split('?')[0], status: r.status, kept: r.headers.get('X-AccessRoles-Kept') }); }, () => {}); } return p; }; })()

steps.script: await ApiClient.updateDisplayPreferences('usersettings', __vars.prefsBefore, ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), 'emby'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const sorted = (o) => JSON.stringify(Object.keys(o || {}).sort().map((k) => [k, o[k]])); const p = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), 'emby'); return sorted(p.CustomPrefs) === sorted(__vars.prefsBefore.CustomPrefs);
